title: Count Digits in a String
statement: Given a string text, return how many digit characters it contains.
think: What is the task asking? Count how many characters are digits.
What is the key operation? Check each character with char.IsDigit.
What wording signals stand out? Count digits, string.
What is the brute force idea? No more than a single pass is needed.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass with a counter.
What are the edge cases? No digits, all digits, mixed symbols.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I iterate once and increment a counter for every digit.
interview: I would solve it with a single pass through the string and count characters for which char.IsDigit returns true.
ru: Идём по строке один раз и считаем только те символы, которые являются цифрами.
visualExplanation:
text = "Anna123"

gaps: Important: basic char API in C#
Nice to have: explain linear scan confidently
constraints: Assume text length is small to medium.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan because each character is checked once with a simple condition.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because no frequency map is needed.
Not HashSet, because uniqueness is irrelevant.
